summary: Fractal web: attach or paste up to four PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images of at most 10 MiB, upload on send, announce refusals and keep staged images removable when upload permission changes

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

schema.detail: No schema change. Uses the existing blob upload route and message.send attachments.

compatibility.detail: Attach appears only on devices granted control.messages and message.send. Staged images stay removable if upload permission disappears, and removing them restores text-only sending.

recovery.detail: Revert the pull request; text sends are unchanged.
